Hello everyone, and welcome to the Foxy Haus Club, the first story I made after the vacation, so it's kinda short, around 285 pictures long. But it's a really good story, I enjoyed making it a lot. The story is about a woman who is trying to infiltrate, or rather enter, the "Foxy Haus Club", a very prestigeous saloon/place of pleasure that only opens a couple days a year. The protagonist is called "J", and she will do anything to get in there and find out whatever it is they're doing, evil or not, she will get in!

The protagonist is from another artist's game called "Unbind" by "OPTheFlavour", you can check his game and art on twitter, it's really good! It involves latex, tentacles, and some degree of "mind manipulation" (if you know what I mean). Here's the link for you to check his content!
https://linktr.ee/optheflavour
